entries.mem0ai/mem0: This universal memory layer provides multi-level storage for user, session, and agent states using temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval. It is an official Hermes Agent provider available as a managed cloud service or an Apache-2.0 self-hosted server.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: This AGPL-3.0 context database organizes agent memory as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs and a three-tier loading system. It serves as an official Hermes provider, achieving significant token reduction and task-completion gains by archiving sessions as editable Markdown files.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: Cognee is a self-hosted knowledge graph engine that grants agents persistent long-term memory by distilling session lessons into searchable records. It supports local extraction and embedding models, allowing for memory construction from text, code, and conversations without requiring LLM API keys.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: This memory engine features a custom vector graph engine and byte-level deduplication to support sub-300ms recall at high scales. As an official Hermes provider, it maintains auto-updated user profiles and supports multi-modal extraction from sources including PDFs, images, and video.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This opinionated agent brain facilitates institutional memory through keyword retrieval, semantic search, and automated background enrichment. It exposes memory to agents via MCP on Tailscale tailnets, offering scoped access for team-based environments.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight implements long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows to help agents learn over time. It includes an LLM wrapper for disposition-aware response generation and supports deployment via Docker, Kubernetes, or bare-metal environments.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: Honcho is a FastAPI-based memory library that serves as the upstream foundation for the Hermes self-hosted wrapper. It provides Python and TypeScript SDKs to build stateful agents across managed, local, and self-hosted deployment options.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: This official Hermes provider treats memory as a git repository, utilizing version control actions like commit and merge to manage a markdown context tree. It features a 5-tier retrieval system where four tiers are non-LLM based, enabling sub-100ms performance via a React-powered TUI.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Mnemosyne is a zero-dependency memory system that utilizes a single SQLite database to achieve sub-millisecond performance for Hermes Agents. It features episodic compression for sub-linear storage growth and integrates via MCP, Python SDK, or OpenWebUI.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer memory system for Hermes Agent combines vector search on Qdrant with structured facts and an auto-curated wiki. It uses a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize injected context within a local infrastructure powered by Docker, Redis, and SQLite.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: This recursive self-improving harness generates filesystem-first artifacts like traces and context bundles to assist agents with complex tasks. It features outcome-gated promotion, ensuring context changes are only adopted based on verified trials.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This Lossless Context Management plugin uses a hierarchical DAG and SQLite store to ensure no messages are lost during agent operations. It provides specialized recall tools like lcm_grep and lcm_recall to help Hermes Agents recover specific details from persistent message history.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: This tool indexes local session history from 34 different coding agents to enable search across months of past activity. It provides an MCP tool for cross-agent retrieval and automatically redacts keys and tokens during the indexing process.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This self-hosted backend enables private cross-session memory for Hermes Agent using Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis. It supports local inference servers or any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider for flexible deployment.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur utilizes an open engram YAML format to store plain-text memory on local disks for multi-agent systems. It features hybrid retrieval via BM25 and local embeddings, offering an MCP server for tool portability.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet provides a local-first identity and memory layer that syncs state across Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and other harnesses. It supports real-time ingestion from Obsidian, Discord, and GitHub, achieving high accuracy in LongMemEval benchmarks.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: This on-device context engine operates locally without cloud dependencies or API keys. It employs hybrid retrieval, including vector search and BM25, and integrates through MCP and Claude Code hooks.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory is a file-based long-term memory system that uses a five-tier hierarchical SQLite schema instead of vector databases or embeddings. It includes a specialized Hermes adapter and supports Linux, macOS, and Windows environments.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This project optimizes context through block reordering and deduplication to accelerate LLM inference and save tokens. It features native plugin support for the Hermes Agent ecosystem and reduces prefill latency by up to 3x.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This embedded plugin provides explainable retrieval by tagging every recall with a reason for its selection. It includes primitives for tracking contradictions and a self-directing loop to identify knowledge gaps.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn uses an Obsidian vault as a source of truth, storing durable memory as inspectable Markdown files. It utilizes a local DuckDB cache for hybrid search and integrates with coding agents via MCP servers.
entries.JanYork/llm-wiki-cli: This CLI maintains agent-driven wikis with citations and provenance to evolve persistent knowledge across sessions. It stores data in SQLite with rebuildable Markdown projections and supports portable archives for merging wiki data.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: Flowstate-qmd features an anticipatory cache that prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs. It is a local-first system using SQLite-vec and node-llama-cpp, provided as an MCP-native server.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack acts as a memory kernel that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner. It manages state using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to deliver evidence packets to the agent for each query.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: This context layer resolves live workspace states into verified facts to ensure agents only load necessary data. It features local-first session history tracking and supports MCP-native integration via stdio or SSE servers.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This reflective memory system utilizes BM25 full-text search and ranked graph traversal for information retrieval. It automates indexing for codebases and multimedia while using edge tags to create bidirectional relationships between notes.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: Designed for Hermes Agent v0.14.0, this tool reduces prompt token overhead through local BM25 tool ranking. It includes a dedicated dashboard to track estimated schema token savings and supports native tool search.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: This Git-backed workflow layer manages context updates for coding agents using hash-checked proposals and receipts. It provides a source-neutral migration path for exporting chats and documents across supported platforms.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin uses an embedded .lbdb graph database to surface high-priority memories via 1-10 importance ranking. It combines BM25 keyword search with named graph relationships and optional entity extraction.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This episodic memory plugin features a pull-model that supports immediate event deletion and an on-demand summarizer. It maintains a trace.jsonl audit log to provide a transparent record of every prefetch and memory operation.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables agents to manage budget-bound wallets for x402 payments across multiple blockchain families. The system operates without a backend or API keys, allowing agents to pay for services using stablecoins.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes local skills, scripts, and MCP configurations to facilitate knowledge search and neighbor traversal. It also supports automatic tool-OKF generation through detached model calls.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider enables cross-session continuity by allowing agents to read memories from other connected instances. It utilizes native lifecycle hooks for session snapshots and a local SQLite layer for reliable caching.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 to provide self-organizing long-term memory for agents. It includes tools for manual memory storage and supports configurable query expansion and result reranking.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This tool adds deterministic slash commands for searching and syncing private local code repositories. It requires a local SourceVault server to handle indexing and vector storage for grounded Q&A.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This memory solution provides AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports HNSW ANN, sparse, and FM-index retrieval. It can be executed via native Rust FFI or as an HTTP daemon and includes MinHash deduplication.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 specialized tools for managing memory and traversing knowledge graphs through a hybrid search approach that combines BM25, vector, and graph methods. It enhances agent efficiency by implementing automatic context checkpointing during the message compression process.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: This file-based kit focuses on memory hygiene by using a git-backed directory to manage versioned markdown files without a database. It features dedicated 'rot' and 'lint' curators that identify stale or conflicting information and propose evidence-cited diffs for manual review.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework automates specification elicitation and implementation planning while adhering to TDD, YAGNI, and DRY principles. It functions as a software development methodology that integrates with multiple coding harnesses and CLI tools.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first system that enables Hermes Agent to generate web, mobile, and motion graphic artifacts through a CLI. It supports native agent runtimes via the DeepSeek Harness and exports designs to formats including HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This library provides 818 structured security skills mapped to frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF 2.0, and ATLAS. It is compatible with over 26 AI platforms, offering coverage across 34 distinct security domains.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill converts codebases, infrastructure-as-code, and schemas into draw.io diagrams using natural language descriptions. It includes a CLI and MCP server that support incremental synchronization while preserving manual layout changes.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Serving as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this tool provides a master router for natural-language mandates and ERC-7710 delegated permissions. it incorporates x402 payments, escrow, and a dedicated dispute resolution layer for secure transactions.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI writing patterns for agents like Hermes and Claude Code. It offers three distinct operational modes: detect-only, edit-in-place, and full rewrite.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This agentic evolver automates skill deduplication and cross-pollination across isolated agent silos for Hermes and OpenAI-compatible APIs. It features a bilingual dashboard for inspecting session traces and monitoring collective skill evolution.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library featuring 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills compatible with agent-plugins.org specifications. It maintains session state directly within a project's documentation folder to support Claude Code and other agents.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection contains 1,162 professional skills for tasks ranging from PRD creation to lease decoding. The skills run natively in Hermes Agent and are provided as markdown files for easy export to other assistants.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This plugin enables Hermes Agent to perform video searches, browse channels, and extract transcripts or playlist data. It requires a TranscriptAPI key and is compatible with multiple environments including OpenClaw and Windsurf.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable skill patterns. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python plugin scaffolds, managed through integrated slash commands.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: These skills enable Hermes Agent to generate its own custom thinking instructions and analytical prompts for specific tasks. The system utilizes pre-built analytical lenses and provides reports that highlight potential analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project provides type-safe agentskills.io support for Pydantic AI, featuring remote skill registries via S3 and Git. It is essential for secure extensibility through sandboxed execution of untrusted scripts and bundled resource management.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This tool enables literate programming by weaving prose, diagrams, and source code into .lit.md files. It allows agents to maintain synchronized documentation through a tangler that extracts runnable source files and syncs edits back to the document.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: These pre-build skills transform rough ideas into structured design documents and implementation handoffs. The workflow includes Lite and Full modes to handle varying project complexities and a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Maestro is a harness for long-running agents that implements the SLP v2 cooperative-agent protocol for supervised teams. It operates on Bun without a background service, using a CLI-driven mechanism kernel to manage decisions, work, and evidence.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin facilitates cross-instance shared memory using markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It further supports agent evolution through a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community project offers agentskills.io compatible skills, guides, and integrations in Portuguese. It provides practical production support for VPS, backups, and cron automation, alongside integrations for WhatsApp, Slack, Discord, and Telegram.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: These skills enable agent interaction with smart contracts and oracle networks via the Agent Skills specification. They provide integrations for VRF, Data Feeds, Data Streams, and CCIP, installable through the Vercel open skills ecosystem CLI.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: This official suite provides BFL API integration for FLUX image and video generation, including polling and webhooks. It includes eight specialist skills specifically for the FLUX 3 video suite and detailed prompting guidelines.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This utility converts developer discourse, documentation, and repositories into agentskills.io-compliant skills. It automates the briefing, creation, testing, and exporting process while linking instructions to specific documentation URLs or file lines.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika is a local-first workflow language for AI delivered as a Rust binary using four core verbs: infer, invoke, exec, and agent. It ensures transparency by providing verification journals and local traces for every execution.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry for reusable AI skills based on the AgentSkills specification includes a CLI and Python SkilldockClient. It supports recursive dependency resolution for skill installation and incorporates TON payments for commerce features.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill manages complex, multi-step autonomous tasks with real-time tracking of decisions and progress. It is designed for long-running operations and includes built-in rollback procedures for safe recovery.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication via HTTPS and includes a guided setup script for credential validation.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: Operating as a community hub for skill discovery and one-click installation, this project implements the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It features federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face while running autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during tool discovery. It employs a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and incrementally discovers server metadata and schemas.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This project provides a five-layer retrieval system that uses hard triggers and semantic embeddings to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. By filtering relevant skills, it reduces token consumption and offers graceful degradation if dependencies are missing.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Designed as an ADHD-friendly execution system, this project uses MCP connections to allow Hermes Agent to drive scheduling and system design. It stores all data in a local SQLite file and provides interfaces via a React web app and Expo-based Android application.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This read-only code review skill uses three parallel subagents to perform adversarial attacks and edge-case analysis on code. It combines deterministic pre-scans using tools like Semgrep and Bandit with verified findings through proof-of-concept execution in a sandbox.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin optimizes and scores prompts across multiple interfaces such as CLI, Discord, and Telegram while supporting 97 languages. It is designed to reduce token usage by 20–80% per rewrite based on five quality dimensions.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill employs parallel agents focused on hygiene, clarity, and correctness to simplify codebases. It supports five major programming languages and includes a tiered application process with a mandatory approval gate.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements a systematic investigation protocol and multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It includes a Python goal engine to manage persistent task states and prevent early-stop issues during debugging.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based skill loading. It supports progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files and automates the registration of common agent skill directories.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey cybersecurity lab provides over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for network forensics and exploitation. It integrates 28 frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK and NIST, to facilitate work with real exploits spanning 2015 to 2026.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This toolkit adds session management and worktree recovery to provide memory between agent conversations and detect state drift. It also orchestrates parallel subagents for architectural reviews and provides scaffolding for new skill development.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: This local-first dashboard provides real-time observability for Hermes Agent through 11 monitoring tabs covering token costs, session health, and error tracking. It enforces a strict read-only boundary with zero outbound telemetry, ensuring all monitoring data remains private to the local environment.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill automates the creation of reproducible demo GIFs for repositories by generating recording scripts via vhs or Playwright. It manages the entire pipeline from rendering and compression to embedding the final optimized file into a README.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This tool enables terminal-based searching of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills, providing direct installation commands for discovered plugins. It is designed for integration with MCP-compatible clients including Hermes, Cursor, and Claude Code.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This utility generates portable agent skills from plain language while monitoring official frontmatter specifications to detect and report drift. It includes a validator with CI-friendly exit codes to ensure skills remain compatible with specific runtime profiles.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This host-agnostic framework establishes a self-improvement loop by analyzing session history to propose skill coverage updates. It operates locally using the Python standard library and gates all updates behind deterministic and LLM-judge evaluators.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: This project provides deterministic path routing and Python runtime selection across Windows, Git Bash, and WSL environments. It allows Hermes Agent to verify project-compatible interpreters and handle environment-specific file syntax without new installations.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates USDC payments for HTTP 402 responses using protocols like Pay Link and x402. It is compatible with the agentskills.io standard and supports integration with OpenClaw and Hermes Agent.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection offers specialized tools for video transcription, OCR, and e-commerce material generation. It features a rule-based engine to remove common AI writing patterns and utilizes macOS Vision to extract structured data from PDFs and images.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This project certifies the quality of AI agent skills by testing their structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It issues cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures to confirm a skill works as intended.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin allows users to earn USDC on the Base network by answering support bounties without requiring an account or API key. It includes tools for listing bounties and managing boards, with payments facilitated via x402 after human approval.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This hosted MCP server exposes 191 tools and five production-grade workflow skills for structured web data access across 31 platforms. It is designed to support multiple agent environments including Hermes, Claude, and Cursor.
entries.superagnt/leverage: This toolkit provides skills and blueprints for social data enrichment, web scraping, and lead prospecting based on the agentskills.io standard. It enables automated tasks such as newsletter drafting and includes a workspace Postgres integration for data management.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill enables Hermes Agent to generate multi-scale Chinese news briefings ranging from global events down to street-level updates. It produces structured reports featuring core conclusions and action suggestions while utilizing semantic memory to align search expansions with specific user interests.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides daily-updated Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes and tools from major providers like OpenAI and Google. It serves as a specialized distribution layer for users who require reproducible development environments and automated package maintenance.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone offers an automated installer and configuration guides for running the Antigravity CLI and OpenClaw on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It enables hardware and UI interaction by leveraging Termux:API and Termux:GUI for mobile agent operations.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a Termux-based automated installation script that utilizes proot-distro Ubuntu to run Hermes Agent on Android. The setup supports shell command execution and interactive model configuration through both external providers and local Ollama instances.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates the deployment of Hermes Agent on Kubernetes with a focus on cloud-native state safety. It enforces single-writer access for persistent storage and supports both direct deployments and operator-ready CRD workflows.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: Providing a one-command installer for both Android and iOS, this project brings Hermes to mobile platforms via Termux and iSH. It distinguishes itself by integrating with Telegram for voice and file messaging and supporting scheduled tasks through cron jobs.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw focuses on high-security deployments by implementing hardware-enforced sandboxing via NVIDIA OpenShell. It provides kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access, allowing for granular security policies regarding web searches and messaging.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane designed to deploy and monitor Hermes agents across Docker and Kubernetes environments. It features a 69-entry credential catalog, support for over 17 LLM providers, and mandatory AES-256-GCM encryption for all secrets.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a straightforward Docker sandbox image that bundles the official Hermes installation with mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted directories and allows users to target specific Hermes versions using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This NixOS module enables declarative configuration of Hermes Agent deployments, including workspace documents and CLI settings. It offers a hybrid skill management system and integrates with sops-nix for secure handling of secrets via systemd.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ acts as a Docker-first control plane for managing multiple agent instances with separate workspaces and RBAC-controlled access. The platform supports inter-agent delegation with hierarchy-aware communication and enterprise MCP access for external clients.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: Targeting production environments on Ubuntu and Debian, this project configures the Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service. It is designed for headless operation, enabling the autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and Nous Portal integration.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable distribution that runs from external drives without requiring host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools to support Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in offline or isolated environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework organizes specialized agents into a multi-tier structure of researchers, traders, and portfolio managers for financial analysis. It enables backtesting across various LLM providers and data vendors to evaluate fundamental, sentiment, and technical trading strategies.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform governs agent registration, task dispatching, and cost tracking through a centralized Web UI or CLI. It supports multi-agent workflows with integrated memory browsing and can be deployed locally via Node.js or Docker.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This control surface manages multiple coding agents, including Hermes Agent, using tmux for persistent background execution and Docker for sandboxed environments. Users can monitor agent activity and review code diffs through both TUI and web-based dashboards.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This execution engine is the first to manage Hermes agents on the Solana blockchain while supporting the Claude-style MCP protocol in stdio mode. It features specialized detection for HTTP signals to handle payment-required states for paid API services.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: Utilizing a level-based architecture, this template scales Hermes Agent from single VPS instances to automated teams using a task bus pattern for delegation. It includes bundled skills for infrastructure tasks such as security auditing, VPS provisioning, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework facilitates the creation of autonomous agent swarms with durable memory and support for over 23 LLM providers. It features visual org charts to manage agent team delegation and integrates with MCP tools for expanded capabilities.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface provides a Kanban board and live streaming of agent reasoning to supervise autonomous Hermes Agent tasks. It emphasizes human-in-the-loop verification, requiring manual approval for all agent-proposed task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system employs a strict pipeline architecture to coordinate 17 specialized agents across research, planning, and infrastructure domains. A Master Orchestrator manages the routing and coordination of these agents to ensure structured task execution.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local collaboration system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents using Hermes Agent profiles and a real-time Web UI. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols to handle local tools and communication throughout the automated task lifecycle.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark code for Hermes Agent, referencing Arxiv research for its methodology. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while tracking candidate mutations and frontier progress.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents across two competing AI companies to track performance metrics and GitHub star growth. It utilizes Hermes Agent for task execution and provides a real-time dashboard to visualize code and scoreboard data.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: Optimized for consumer GPUs, this fully-local framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack using Hermes for task routing and tool-calling. It eliminates cloud dependencies by running parallel model querying and synthesis via Ollama.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, Rust-powered code knowledge graph that reduces token usage and tool calls for coding agents. It features an MCP server for integration and automatically syncs the index on every file change to ensure data remains current.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale is a CLI-based utility that tracks token usage and costs across multiple AI coding agents, including Hermes and Claude Code. It offers a TUI and a 3D visualization dashboard, with options to submit data to a public leaderboard.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer allows developers to inspect API traffic from coding agents like Hermes and Cursor. It generates self-contained HTML viewers for trace sessions and automatically redacts common authentication headers during recording.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time tracking of token usage, costs, and rate limits by reading agent states directly. It supports multi-device synchronization and offers historical usage breakdowns categorized by specific sessions and projects.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to assist in building user interfaces with AI. It is compatible with any provider supporting markdown and integrates directly with Hermes Agent, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This opinionated workflow layer coordinates seven specialized agents to build and operate applications. It loads 36 skills and 6 workflows, supporting autonomous execution on both laptops and VPS environments.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: This project enables customization of the Hermes terminal UI through YAML-based themes and skins. Users can modify ASCII art banners, spinner styles, and colors to achieve aesthetics ranging from retro DOS to cyberpunk.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform establishes a social economy for autonomous agents by providing encrypted messaging via the Signal Protocol. It supports identity registration with human-readable handles and facilitates commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This port brings the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills natively into the Claude Code Channel without requiring external processes or OAuth. It includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM inference, GGUF, and reinforcement learning training.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel is an AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control through a supervisor sidebar that manages approvals and checkpoints. It supports external MCP clients and browser automation workflows across multiple AI providers.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides memory integrations for frameworks like CrewAI and LangGraph using a two-tier system of knowledge graphs and session caches. It extends these memory capabilities to chat platforms including Telegram, Slack, and VS Code.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings during agent workflows. It comes with over 40 pre-configured skills for finance and devops, featuring automated installation for macOS and Linux.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: This static linter performs local, deterministic analysis of AI agent configurations and system prompts without requiring network access. It identifies ambiguous tools and contract mismatches using HERM v1.1 scoring, integrating directly into CI/CD workflows via GitHub Actions and SARIF output.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: Ankh.md is a framework for creating scoped Hermes Agents that utilize per-folder configurations and local skills. It enables seamless switching between default and scoped agents while supporting project-local memories, tools, and custom instructions.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool provides automated installation of a full hermes-agent stack and over 12 supporting services in minutes. It offers three scalable deployment tiers and supports 29 community plugins across six functional categories at zero cost.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility transitions OpenClaw environments to Hermes Agent by mapping SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, and skills into Hermes-compatible YAML and JSON formats. It also configures systemd gateway services and handles nested authentication structures during the migration process.
entries.observeco/observeco: Observeco provides self-healing observability for multi-agent systems through a native Hermes plugin that exports real-time telemetry without cloud dependencies. It uses zero-token passive analysis and active probing to detect performance drift relative to local configuration changes.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: Designed for generating revenue via Hermes Agent, this project operates as a deterministic zero-network local runtime by default. It enforces security by requiring explicit approval for all consequential actions and external writes through specific contracts for opportunities and offers.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This voice-enabled assistant adds offline, open-mic capabilities to Hermes Agent with support for 35 languages and wake-word activation. It features adaptive turn-taking and barge-in functionality without requiring API keys or external accounts.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This memory plugin for Hermes supports multi-dimensional storage and semantic search capabilities. It includes a built-in circuit breaker for API outages and provides dedicated tools for searching, adding, and deleting agent memories.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: Built with the Tauri 2 framework, this cross-platform manager supports Windows, macOS, and Linux. It centralizes configuration management for multiple agentic tools and CLI interfaces, including Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and Gemini CLI.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: This local open-source application facilitates autonomous multi-step tasks with user approval and file access across various agent CLIs. It supports built-in and external agents like Hermes Agent and provides remote access through WebUI, Telegram, and other messaging platforms.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Developed using Python and vanilla JavaScript, this interface allows users to access Hermes Agent via web browsers or mobile devices. It features a circular context ring for monitoring token usage and supports secure connectivity through SSH tunnels.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion application simplifies the deployment of Hermes Agent through guided installation and provider setup. It offers a graphical interface for managing chat sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: This web dashboard provides unified configuration for ten communication platforms, including WhatsApp and Matrix, across runtimes like Hermes and Claude Code. It features a visual workflow builder with cron-based scheduling, approval gates, and usage analytics.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace includes a Monaco-based file browser, PTY terminal, and a memory browser for managing agent skills. It supports a Swarm Mode that utilizes role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers for complex tasks.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Available as a desktop app, standalone server, or Docker container, this collaborative workspace aggregates sessions from Hermes and other agents. It supports fifteen built-in agents and custom ACP-compatible registrations, complemented by native iOS and Android clients.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed as a native Mac workspace, this tool provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts for system repair and shell access. It features an embedded terminal alongside native views for managing sessions, Kanban boards, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first desktop application includes a built-in kernel with health check and update capabilities. The UI supports LaTeX and Markdown rendering for chat and memory management on both Windows and macOS.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects active browser context to local, cloud, or remote Hermes Agent runtimes. It enables multi-agent profile switching and uses AI-assisted tab scoping to manage prompt context and synchronized histories.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: This native SwiftUI iPhone app pairs with a hermes-webui server to drive self-hosted agents from a mobile device. It supports real-time chat streaming with tool-call details, file attachments, and private push notifications via an open-source relay.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: This desktop workspace offers one-click setup for engines like Hermes Agent and Claude Code while providing custom LLM model routing. Users can monitor code writes and diffs in a live workspace while tracking token usage and latency via a runtime dashboard.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This interactive TUI consciousness monitor features nine tabs and four color themes for tracking agent growth and scheduled cron jobs. It includes a tmux operator view designed specifically for managing live agent panes.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard provides a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and an MCP server control plane for managing server lifecycles. It features the ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines alongside real-time tool call visualization.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser that searches prompts, tool calls, and command outputs across local agent histories. It tracks per-session token burn and API costs while allowing users to resume CLI sessions in Terminal.app, iTerm2, or Warp.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS workspace facilitates one-click automated Hermes Agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It integrates a WebRTC voice mode utilizing OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and Tailwind CSS v4, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It includes a dedicated approval inbox for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: Constructed with OpenTUI, this dashboard provides a text-based interface for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It supports task management through a kanban board and allows users to manage profiles, skills, and toolsets.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This mobile-first React SPA functions as a Telegram Mini App, supporting terminal chat with file attachments and streaming responses. It utilizes dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication to manage up to five concurrent background agent instances.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This portable Windows desktop application runs via contained Python and Node.js environments without requiring admin rights or Docker. It features a built-in workflow engine and 100 tools for tasks including TTS, music generation, and ComfyUI image creation.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: This glassmorphic web interface provides real-time log streaming and a task tracking dashboard for self-hosted AI assistants. It includes management tools for skills, cron jobs, MCP servers, and an integrated file browser.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This dashboard focuses on process monitoring by providing real-time session activity and cost tracking. It allows for full inspection of conversation histories and skill source code, alongside read-only monitoring of environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A self-hosted workspace featuring real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards within a chat-first interface. It includes an integrated marketplace for skills and MCP servers, plus isolated profile management for separate API keys and memory.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This native desktop client orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents and supports model switching. It features a Visual Skill Store containing over 50 curated one-click installations.
